canonical_t0.demand_semantics: Kinematic descriptors only; shear may coexist; no process or fault class inferred.

shellset_component_roles.role: Alters/populates FEG nodal lithosphere structure from spatial source datasets and assumptions; derives crust and mantle-lithosphere thickness via local-isostasy/geotherm choices or uses seismic constraints and adds density-anomaly/geotherm-curvature parameters. It does not change FE topology/fault network, classify ARCANA faults, create plate polygons, or generate the generic BCS contract.
shellset_component_roles.optionality: Optional if the FEG already contains the fields needed by the selected SHELLS setup; otherwise required for the selected updates.

shellset_component_roles.role: Finite-element thin-shell quasi-static creeping-flow mechanics. Consumes mesh, lithosphere structure, constitutive parameters, and selected boundary/force conditions; predicts velocity, strain, and fault slip.

Scores SHELLS predictions against supplied observations; geodetic velocities, stress directions, SKS, seismicity, spreading and fault-slip observations are evaluation/calibration inputs, not baseline solver state.
Separate FE grid creation/editing workflow. Owns numerical mesh construction; mesh is derived discretization, not ARCANA's scientific spatial authority.

pygplates_to_shellset_interface.known_contract: .bcs is node-based; prescribed speed in m/s and azimuth clockwise from geographic north. Earth examples constrain slab nodes; temporary fictitious plate-interior anchors occur during iterations and are released from the final BCS file.

mesh_ownership.numerical_mesh_owner: FEG creator (OrbWin or versioned validated mesh producer/adapter).
mesh_ownership.recommendation: Mesh is derived numerical discretization, never new spatial authority. Persist mapping to canonical plate/boundary/junction IDs.
consequences: Geometry/conservation error and branch/junction preservation require measured contracts

boundary_fault_semantics.continuum_without_faults: Supported as an FEG structural option by triangular continuum elements plus optional linear fault elements; suitability for ARCANA not established.
boundary_fault_semantics.accepted_fault_taxonomy: UNKNOWN; Earth PB2002 polarity examples are not universal solver classes.
boundary_fault_semantics.fault_geometry_and_dip: Dip is attached per fault element; conditional on selecting explicit fault elements.

boundary_fault_semantics.arcana_status: BOUNDARY_CLASSIFICATION_GAP; no labels inferred from kinematics.

junction_handling.geometry: ARCANA has 20 degree-three junction identities; transfer to FEG/fault connectivity is unproven.
junction_handling.mechanics: FE continuum may couple connected elements, but reviewed documentation does not prove explicit triple-junction mechanics or closure for ARCANA.
junction_handling.policy: Do not add custom junction law without evidence; require connectivity mapping proof.

patch_operator_disposition.condition: Only if later validation shows the chosen specialist handles the required continuum/fault network and connected mesh. This source audit does not prove ARCANA transfer.

aspect_comparator.comparison: Shares mesh/material, thermo-composition, rheology and boundary/force input needs. ASPECT+GWB does not avoid authorial synthetic physical inputs or make a global production selection.

input_family_counts.counting_note: Non-overlapping ledger count: 9 mandatory + 6 optional/conditional + 6 scoring-only + 3 Earth-example-only families = 24 documented families. Six mandatory physical families: elevation (partial coverage), heat flow, crust thickness, mantle-lithosphere thickness, thermal/density structure, rheology. Three mesh/BC/config families: FEG, selected-node velocity BCs, model/numerical controls. Specialists can materialize representations only after inputs and assumptions are authorized. Parser-level exact mandatory fields/defaults remain UNKNOWN; these counts are documented baseline families, not a claim of source-code parser completeness.
